name: @treaty/federation-deploy
description: Versioned federation manifest + runtime for Treaty apps. Treaty compiles every lazy feature route and library into an independently versioned, deployable, rollback-able federated module; this package is the deployment layer. A FederationManifest maps every moduleId (host + route remotes + libs) to its current { version, url }. buildManifest/serializeManifest/parseManifest produce and round-trip the manifest as JSON; setModuleVersion (deploy) and rollbackModule (rollback) produce a NEW manifest with exactly one module repointed without touching the rest. createTreatyMfRuntimePlugin builds a @module-federation/enhanced runtime plugin that resolves the current url+version of each remote from the manifest at load. On top of the manifest, the CI deployment layer compiles/tests/deploys ONLY the modules a change touches: computeAffectedModules walks a moduleId -> { files, dependsOn } graph (direct edits + transitive shared-lib fan-out); a DeployPlugin interface + DeployPluginRegistry make deploy methods pluggable (with reference NoopDeployPlugin and FsDeployPlugin); and affectedDeployPlan is the CI entry point that returns which modules to compile/test/deploy plus the resulting manifest deltas.
author: Jordan Hall
